title: 3D heading uses the globally nearest segment (jitter on loops/parallel roads; O(n) per render)

title: 3D: 'ready' sent before the style loads; theme-change style failures and later tile failures never fall back
impact: Blank or broken 3D map with no fallback

test_plan: Runtime test with failing style/tile URLs

title: Cached nearby requests bypass the per-client rate limit
impact: One client can hammer the server with cached cells (CPU, bandwidth on free tier)
acceptance_criteria: Explicit policy: limiter runs before cache (or a separate, higher cached limit) and 429 carries Retry-After
test_plan: Test: repeated cached requests cross threshold -> 429; another client unaffected

title: Places quota and queue semantics: quota taken before queued work, no single-flight, budgets per process
impact: Quota leak and duplicated upstream calls under load; budget resets on every Render restart
acceptance_criteria: Identical concurrent misses share one upstream call; budget is reserved when work starts and released on queue-full/abort; one LocationIQ budget per key shared by search + fallback
test_plan: Concurrency test (10 parallel same-cell), abort test, budget accounting test
